(Harisingh s/o Bhagwan Singh v/s State of Madhya Pradesh and another) Indore, Dated : 13.08.2019 :-
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he instead of making submissions on application for suspension of sentence would make final submissions in this matter. Learned counsel submits that he does not seek to challenge the conclusion pertaining to the conviction and further submits that the applicant has since completed term of imprisonment of 6 months already and, therefore, the -: 2 :- Criminal Revision No.1707 of 2019. period of sentence having been completed, this criminal revision be disposed of in above terms. This prayer is also allowed. Harisingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11636149/ 1
